audit.whatIsWrong: TWO hard errors. (a) Shen's Q is called 'vorpal blades' in four places (whys[0], early, spikes[2], wants.you[1]) and credited with sustain/healing. Vorpal Blade is a REMOVED ability; his Q is Twilight Assault, 400 range, 140 energy at rank 1, max-health damage and a slow — Riot's text contains no healing at all. (b) content.early states 'his Spirit's Refuge (W) cannot proc without him landing an auto first'. Riot's W text: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' It is a placed zone requiring nothing from him, and it blocks BASIC ATTACKS ONLY.
audit.why: The auto-only detail is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the page never states it. Riven's damage is half Runic Blade auto-weaving, which Spirit's Refuge deletes — but Broken Wings, Ki Burst, Valor and Wind Slash all pass through it untouched. A player who knows this keeps casting inside the zone instead of walking out of it.
audit.corrected: Every 'vorpal blades' instance replaced with Twilight Assault or Ki Barrier as appropriate, the fabricated sustain removed, and the auto-only block stated plainly in content.early and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number appears anywhere on the page despite 'Track Shadow Dash' being the stated win condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stand United is treated purely as something that happens to you (wants.foe[2], mid, spikes[3]) — the page never says it can be stopped.
audit.why: Stand United is a channel and the kit file marks it 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Your Ki Burst is a point-blank stun on 11 seconds at rank 1 versus a 200-second ultimate. Walking in and W-ing a channelling Shen is the highest-value single action available in this matchup and it was absent from all seven phases and every do/don't.
audit.corrected: Stated in content.mid: W cancels the channel outright.

edits.before: Shen does not spike hard at 4-5 but his sustain and passive Ki Barrier shield mean short trades start to favour him if you cannot land the full pattern — avoid poking without committing. At Level 6 your Blade of the Exile completely flips this: the extended AoE Q and Wind Slash execute mean every all-in at or below half HP is a kill, and he has no mobility to escape once W lands. The critical discipline here is watching his Stand United channel — if he starts it at the turret, shove the wave and roam immediately rather than letting him reset for free; conversely, if you catch him mid-channel during your all-in, E out and reset before his ally can punish your dive.
edits.after: Shen does not spike at 4-5, but Ki Barrier refreshes a shield on every cast, so short trades favour him unless you land the whole pattern — never poke without committing. At Level 6 Blade of the Exile flips this: extended range plus the Wind Slash execute makes any all-in at or below half HP a kill, and Shadow Dash at 18 seconds is his only exit. The discipline that decides the lane is Stand United: it is a channel, so your Ki Burst cancels it outright. If he starts it in lane, walk in and W him rather than letting him leave for free — that is an 11-second stun deleting a 200-second ultimate. If he channels safe under turret, shove and follow him.
